description: This file defines the 'Order' model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling CRUD operations related to customer orders, including adding, editing, deleting orders, and managing related entities like products, totals, options, subscriptions, and histories.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Model class for handling customer orders in OpenCart, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, and delete orders and related entities such as products, options, totals, subscriptions, and histories.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order record in the database with provided order data, including associated products and totals.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order, voids the previous order, merges data, and manages related entities like products, totals, options, and subscriptions.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and all related data, including products, totals, histories, transactions, rewards, and manages stock adjustments.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed order information, including customer and address details, products, totals, options, and subscriptions.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to an order, including options and subscription details.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all products associated with an order.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to an order product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Removes all options associated with an order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific order.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a subscription record for an order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes subscription records associated with an order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the status of an order.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID associated with an order.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Updates the comment for an order.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Adds a total record to an order.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Deletes total records from an order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves all totals associated with an order.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history/status change record for an order, managing stock, rewards, and subscription statuses.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history records for an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders linked to a specific subscription ID.
